dct_creator_sm: Newman, Kiera (School of Environmental Sciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6726-0056
dct_description_sm: This dataset accompanies the PhD dissertation of Kiera Newman (2026), University of Guelph. The archived files contain research data associated with investigations of milkweed, honey bee health, wild bee biodiversity, apiary proximity, and landscape-scale pollinator conservation in the Niagara Region of Ontario, Canada. The accompanying README file provides descriptions of the datasets, their organization, variables, and relevant methodological information. Users are encouraged to consult the dissertation for additional details regarding study design, data collection, statistical analyses, and interpretation of results.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Pollinator biodiversity and conservation are supported by multi-scale assessments of individual, community and landscape level influences on milkweed-based pollination hubs in the Niagara Region of Ontario, Canada
